algorithm: PPO (teacher, privileged state) + DAgger imitation distillation to a depth-point-cloud student (two-stage: synthetic-PC pretrain then rendered-occluded-PC fine-tune)
success_criterion: orientation error <=0.4 rad (also reported at <=0.8 rad) between object and goal, via a three-part stop criterion (orientation error + finger-motion + object-motion all under threshold)
headline_metric: real-robot success rate at orientation error <=0.4 rad, on-table (Table 1)
headline_value: soft fingertips: train objects 79% [71,86]%, OOD test objects 55% [44,62]%; rigid fingertips: train 81% [73,90]%, test 45% [32,58]%; simulation: train 96% [94,97]%, test 85% [82,88]% (Table 1)
paper_code_mismatch: Table S1 states 32000 teacher training environments, but the released config sets alg.num_envs to 8000 (parent config 16384); fallDistance differs across two shipped configs (0.24 vs 0.15, only the latter matching Table S1's threshold); the paper's Eq 8 penultimate-joint penalty (c7=-2) does not appear anywhere in the released reward code; the config carries a dead distRewardScale=-10.0 key never used in compute_reward; and the paper's table-friction lower bound (0.05) differs by a factor of 10 from the code's randomized lower bound (0.005).
note_gaps: the paper's reward equations (Eq 1-8) are embedded as images and were not recoverable as text from the PDF conversion; the quoted equations/coefficients are reconstructed from surrounding prose and Table S1 constants, not read directly off the formulas.
